_note: Base file holds universal rubrics + structural placeholders. Prayer texts MUST come from a translation overlay (see fixed-texts/translations/<id>/kneeling-vespers-fixed.json). St. Tikhon's Sluzhebnik does not publish kneeling prayers (Pentecostarion content); the sts-sluzhebnik overlay carries a ROCOR-EAD Thee/Thou text as a stand-in until an OCA Pentecostarion edition is sourced.

_insertionPoints.set1: After the Evening (Great) Prokeimenon, before the Litany of Fervent Supplication.
_insertionPoints.set2: After 'Vouchsafe, O Lord', before the Litany of Completion.
_insertionPoints.set3: After the Litany of Completion, before the Aposticha.

rubrics.kneelingNotice: At this Vespers, served on the evening of Pentecost, the faithful kneel for the first time since Pascha. The priest offers each set of prayers while all kneel; the prayers are concluded with the diaconal call to rise.
rubrics.deaconBidsKneeling: Again and again, on bended knees, let us pray to the Lord.
rubrics.deaconBidsRising: Help us, save us, have mercy on us, raise us up, and keep us, O God, by Thy grace.
rubrics.andHeAdds: And he addeth also this prayer:
